purpose: Freeze one finite zero-network Campaign264 review of the remaining locally identifiable A-share minute and daily channels after Campaign263, and reject old-family estimator, field-substitution, window, path, interaction and model rescue before any Campaign264 value is opened.

metadata_only_source_evidence.schema_observation_method: Parquet footer schema and row-count metadata only; no column chunk, candidate value, comparison value, daily price series or forward return was loaded for Campaign264.
metadata_only_source_evidence.interpretation: The accepted local raw inventory contains only standard daily and aggregate one-minute OHLC, share-volume and CNY-amount channels. A new statistic over those already exposed channels is not automatically a new economic information state.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: intraday_realized_return_excess_kurtosis_238m
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The frozen return-skewness protocol explicitly closed kurtosis, tail-index, maximum standardized return and tail-count alternatives; Campaign110 again rejected realized excess kurtosis as a restatement of return-variance entropy, bipower jump variation and volatility resolution.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: intraday_range_profile_spectral_entropy_60f
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Campaign064 selected one exact range weak-order entropy and rejected range spectral, permutation and transition entropy before values; later range entropy, clock moment, peak, profile and synchronization results make a Fourier operator substitution an exposed estimator rescue.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: intraday_volume_profile_spectral_entropy_60f
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Campaign263 consumed the exact full-profile spectral-entropy operator on CNY amount. Campaign117 previously rejected choosing share volume instead of amount as a field sweep, and Campaign152 documented that raw share volume adds lot and corporate-action denomination exposure rather than a cleaner independent liquidity channel.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: intraday_amount_direction_dictionary_phrase_count_238s
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Campaign120 explicitly rejected an amount-direction dictionary after the amount weak-order and top-decile event-state routes. Replacing the already-consumed finite activity alphabet with a dictionary parser is a sequence-complexity estimator refresh, not a new source state.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: intraday_day_over_day_high_low_range_profile_similarity_240b
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Campaign057 rejected the same cross-day range-profile similarity before values, and Campaign100 preserved that rejection because range participation entropy and morning-afternoon range-profile similarity had already consumed the family.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: intraday_zero_activity_or_zero_range_longest_run_240m
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Campaign105 and Campaign106 selected minimal occupancy shares and rejected longest inactive or zero-range runs because ordering, lunch reset, endpoints and ties add path/window degrees of freedom to already exposed binary support states.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: full_numeric_library_pair_interaction_reweight_or_model_143f
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Complete-library supervised fits, subsets, pair interactions, consensus, lower-quartile, improvement-breadth, redundancy weighting and latent-model refreshes are already terminal. Recombining the 143 observed numeric comparators after their outcomes would violate the frozen no-rescue and no-terminated-factor-combination boundary.

decision.reason: No route is both economically independent of the complete frozen history and identifiable from a not-yet-consumed accepted local raw channel. Forcing one would manufacture iteration by changing an estimator, field, window or combination after exposure.
decision.next_campaign_requirement: Start only from a genuinely new accepted point-in-time information channel or a mechanism that can prove independence from all seven rejected routes and the complete 162-definition library before values. Historical offline review remains available at any local time.
